items.title: Hyundai Glovis and LGL to study SMR-powered car carrier operations
items.summary: Hyundai Glovis and Liberty Global Logistics signed an agreement on September 30 to assess the commercial, regulatory and operational requirements for an SMR-powered PCTC service between South Korea and the United States. The project concerns a future vessel concept and none of the 44 monitored ships.

items.title: New long-term car carrier charter for Hyundai Glovis
items.summary: Korea Shipping Corporation announced a 73 billion won charter with Hyundai Glovis, due to run from November for five years and four months. This concerns the wider operating fleet; the article does not identify one of the 44 monitored vessels.

items.title: Glovis Lighthouse makes first European port call at Southampton
items.source: The Maritime Executive / Associated British Ports
items.summary: Glovis Lighthouse called at Southampton on July 14 during its maiden voyage, becoming the port's largest vehicle carrier by capacity. The 10,800-CEU ship belongs to the wider Hyundai Glovis operating fleet and is not one of the 44 monitored vessels.

items.title: Hyundai Glovis deploys 10,800-vehicle Glovis Leader
items.summary: Hyundai Glovis announced the deployment of Glovis Leader after its April 28 delivery. The LNG dual-fuel PCTC can carry 10,800 vehicles; it is part of the wider operating fleet and is not one of the 44 monitored vessels.

items.title: Middle East disruption forces Hyundai Glovis route changes
items.summary: Hyundai Glovis said on April 3 that some Middle East routes were inaccessible, requiring temporary cargo storage and diversions through hubs including Sri Lanka. Reuters did not identify any of the 44 monitored vessels.

items.title: First 10,800-CEU PCTC for HMM-Hyundai Glovis partnership floated out
items.summary: Guangzhou Shipyard International floated out the first 10,800-CEU vehicle carrier for the HMM-Hyundai Glovis partnership on January 21. The ship was subsequently named Glovis Leader and is outside the 44-vessel watchlist.
